socks5_domain_max_len.source: RFC 1928 §5: the domain name is prefixed by a one-octet length

socks5_message_sizes.source: my arithmetic from the field layouts in RFC 1928 §3-6 (VER, CMD/REP, RSV, ATYP, address, 2-byte port)

socks_listen_port_illustrative.source: design parameter; chosen away from socks5_conventional_port to avoid clashes with other software

allowed_ports_illustrative.unit: destination TCP ports allowed by the phone filter
allowed_ports_illustrative.source: design parameter: the HTTP and HTTPS well-known ports only (first release)

blocked_ranges_ipv4.source: the cited RFCs; IANA special-purpose address registry (RFC 6890)

value.::ffff:0:0/96: IPv4-mapped: apply the IPv4 rules to the embedded address (RFC 4291 §2.5.5.2)

metadata_address.source: link-local address used by the instance metadata services of several public clouds (provider documentation); inside RFC 3927 169.254.0.0/16

metadata_address_encodings.unit: alternative spellings accepted by inet_aton-style parsers
metadata_address_encodings.source: my arithmetic from metadata_address; the encodings are the classic SSRF filter bypasses listed in the OWASP SSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet

documentation_addresses.source: RFC 5737; RFC 3849 (all example addresses in this kit come from these ranges)

quic_first_stream_ids.source: my arithmetic from RFC 9000 §2.1: IDs of one type increase by 4

page_dns_answers_01.source: page model choice (not in constants.json): names reserved by RFC 2606; public answers from the RFC 5737 documentation ranges (documentation_addresses). The phone's resolver picks a server near the user, the cloud's one near the cloud region. 192.168.1.1 is an RFC 1918 address standing in for a home router (DNS rebinding, C1)

quic_handshake_round_trips.source: RFC 9000 §7 and RFC 9001 §4; RFC 8446 §2 (TLS 1.3 1-RTT); TCP three-way handshake (RFC 9293) adds one; my arithmetic for the sums

rtt_cloud_phone_illustrative.source: round round-trip times between a cloud region and a phone

rtt_phone_site_illustrative.source: round RTT from the phone's network to a nearby site

rtt_cloud_site_illustrative.source: round RTT from a cloud region to a site

phone_dns_typical_illustrative.source: round resolver time on the phone

ttfb_model_illustrative.unit: ms to first response byte (server time excluded)
ttfb_model_illustrative.source: my arithmetic in A1 from the rtt_* and phone_dns_typical_illustrative values: method 1 x RTTcp + CONNECT (RTTcp + DNS + RTTps) + TLS 1.3 (RTTcp + RTTps) + HTTP (RTTcp + RTTps); pipelined removes one RTTcp; direct = 3 x RTTcs

phone_max_incoming_streams_illustrative.source: design parameter: the effective concurrency cap of the whole tunnel

streams_per_page_illustrative.unit: tunnel streams per browser page load
streams_per_page_illustrative.source: illustrative relation: a bypass list for analytics/ads/CDN telemetry cuts tunnel streams by about ten times

heavy_page_concurrency_illustrative.unit: concurrent tunnel streams on a resource-heavy page
heavy_page_concurrency_illustrative.source: illustrative; the relation taught is that one browser page can approach phone_max_incoming_streams_illustrative

page_loss_02.unit: fraction of packets lost on the cloud-phone leg
page_loss_02.source: page model choice (not in constants.json): round loss rates to drive the head-of-line model; not measurements

page_packets_per_connection_02.source: page model choice (not in constants.json): one small page resource

conn_idle_timeout_illustrative.source: design parameter (QUIC max_idle_timeout on both ends)

keepalive_illustrative.source: design parameter: below udp_nat_idle_assumption and below one third of conn_idle_timeout_illustrative

udp_nat_idle_assumption.source: RFC 9308 §3.2 (applications can assume a NAT binding may expire after 30 s of inactivity)

rfc4787_udp_mapping_timer.source: RFC 4787 REQ-5 (many deployed NATs are shorter; that is why RFC 9308 assumes 30 s)

quic_idle_timeout_min_pto_multiple.source: RFC 9000 §10.1 (effective idle timeout is the minimum of both endpoints' values, and at least three PTOs)

relay_idle_timeout_illustrative.unit: s without a byte in either direction

stream_open_timeout_illustrative.source: design parameter: listener waits this long to open a stream to the phone

short_lived_threshold_illustrative.source: design parameter: a tunnel that dies sooner than this counts as a failure for backoff

page_timeline_03.source: page model choice (not in constants.json): when the phone leaves Wi-Fi, how long it has no network, and the length of the drawn timeline

quic_amplification_factor.unit: x bytes received from an unvalidated address

page_flight_04.unit: bytes in the server's first flight
page_flight_04.source: page model choice (not in constants.json): order of magnitude for a flight with one small self-signed P-256 certificate (B4) versus a longer certificate chain

page_retry_token_04.source: page model choice (not in constants.json): the token length is the server's choice (RFC 9000 §8.1.2 leaves it open)

page_abandoned_handshake_04.unit: s a server keeps state for a handshake that never completes
